events.title: Frozen-order exact residual-CNF DAG hits transition-work cap before state cap on GT12 residue
interpretation: The frozen lane did not hit its state-count cap; it hit the transition-maintenance work cap while repeatedly scanning large residual CNFs.
This result does not establish an ROBDD or residual-state size lower bound.
An incremental/persistent cofactor data structure could improve this implementation and remains a separate route.
The result localizes a mandatory cost column Q_discovery/Q_state-update for the frozen implementation.

events.title: Exact JANUS graph-tautology encoding has a deterministic cubic Resolution schema; GT12 reclassified as positive control
events.external_alignment: Buss and Johannsen, On Linear Resolution, Theorem 14: ordering principles / graph tautologies have O(n^3) linear Resolution refutations.
formal_statement: For the exact JANUS graph_tautology_cnf(n) encoding, a deterministic recursive Resolution generator derives GT_{m-1} non-minimality clauses from GT_m using (m-1)^2 inferences per level.
One final GT_2 inference yields the empty clause.
Total inference count is SUM_{r=1}^{n-1} r^2 = (n-1)n(2n-1)/6.
For n=12 the exact count is 506 Resolution inferences.

active_front.name: PF5_UNIVERSAL_SCHEMA_SELECTOR_AND_UPPER_BOUND_AUDITED_RED_BENCHMARK
active_front.question: Can the organism recognize and generate the appropriate exact polynomial schema/quotient for every CNF without semantic oracle or exponential schema search, and what is the first frozen family/state escaping the admitted operator portfolio after known upper-bound audit?
next_actions: Add GT_LINEAR_RESOLUTION_SCHEMA to the PF5 operator portfolio as a cheap syntactically recognized family-specific operator.
Freeze a benchmark-admission protocol requiring same-system/stronger-system polynomial upper-bound audit before red-family use.
Select the next adversarial family only after that audit; random sparse unsatisfiable 3-CNF is a candidate discovery stress family, not a claimed ER-hard family.
